Completed the standard-depth search build. The single-line PubMed query is in [final_strategy.txt](C:/Users/aaron/AppData/Local/Temp/psb-evals/run-62327eccbc31903b/ours-codex-noseed-20260927T151508Z/final_strategy.txt); the [audit](C:/Users/aaron/AppData/Local/Temp/psb-evals/run-62327eccbc31903b/ours-codex-noseed-20260927T151508Z/work/audit.md) includes line-by-line counts, assumptions, and the internal critique.

The query returned 15,738 records through the required 2017-08-24 publication cutoff. It retrieved all five screened development records; that relative recall is not independent validation. I assumed “long-term” means at least six months for pilot screening and included OCD and PTSD within “anxiety-related disorders.” An information specialist should PRESS-review the draft before use.
